To find the customer_id with the highest total spending based on the given schema, you can use the following SQL query:

```sql
SELECT customer_id
FROM Orders O
JOIN Products P ON O.product_id = P.product_id
GROUP BY O.customer_id
ORDER BY SUM(O.quantity * P.price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

This query joins the Orders table with the Products table to calculate the total spending for each customer by summing the product of quantity and price, groups the results by customer_id, and then orders them in descending order to get the highest spender at the top. Finally, it limits the result to just one row, which will be the customer with the highest total spending.
